name: ack_evidence_observed_only
why: OBSERVE MODE, the default. w1 is acked nothing_to_do but the worker's event stream shows no successful read of C1, so gate_ack_unverified is logged and the watermark STILL ADVANCES. Enforcing was rejected after review: a false negative is not a one-tick delay, it becomes a misconfig park after three no-progress dispatches, and the known false-negative surface is wide (search-only reads, permalink reads, DM by user id, channel only in the response, other backend schemas).
